subject: MedCross SOC2 intake — authorization custody & service-account map
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@medcrosshealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@medcrosshealth.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intake — authorization custody + service-account mapping for SOC 2 intake

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — MedCross is starting its SOC 2 intake and our security team needs a focused set of artifacts around authorization and identity for the tenant we run on your platform. We're primarily looking for: 

- A tenant-scoped authorization snapshot (role-to-principals mapping) for the last 90 days.
- A sample SCIM delta (add/remove/change) that shows a user lifecycle event and a service-account provisioning event.
- Representative SAML session logs showing assertion timestamps and issuer/audience for web SSO.
- An inventory of service accounts with owner, last-used, and associated role bindings.

Can you confirm what format you can provide these in and whether you can redact anything that might contain PHI? Our compliance team will accept CSV/JSON exports and redacted logs. Ideally we'd like an initial package by end of week so we can include it in our SOC 2 readiness doc.

Also please let us know if you need a signed NDA or an upload link — we can accept a secure Drive folder or a DocuSign package for transfer. I've attached a short scoping questionnaire (scoping_questions_v1.pdf) the reviewer asked us to complete.

Regards,
Anna Li
Security Program Manager
MedCross Health

---

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear ask, and welcome.

We can provide the artifacts you listed. Quick clarifying Qs before we scope a delivery timeline: 

1) Tenant identifier: is this the MedCross-prod tenant (tenant_id: medcross-prod) or a partner sandbox? I want to limit the exports to the correct scope.
2) Redaction: we can redact user identifiers (email -> hashed id) and redact any free-text fields in logs that might surface PHI. Confirm that hashes are acceptable to your auditors.
3) Service accounts: do you want all service accounts or only those with non-zero role bindings in the last 180 days?

Proposed minimal delivery plan: 
- Day 1 (today): confirm tenant_id + redaction rule set and we create a secure Drive folder.
- Day 2–3: produce CSV exports: role_map_90d.csv, service_account_inventory.csv, and example_scim_delta.csv; provide a redacted SAML session sample (saml_session_sample.log).
- Day 4: handover of artifacts + short README describing extraction queries and timestamps.

We will not include any raw user content; only metadata and assertion/session metadata. If that timeline works I'll kick off extracts and CC Karhtik and Marcus to the extraction tasks.

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, Irene.

Confirmed tenant: medcross-prod. Hashing is acceptable; our auditor prefers salted SHA256 if possible. Please include both hashed_id and the original email column in a separate redaction mapping file that stays off the package (we won't store the mapping). For service accounts, provide all accounts that had any role binding or token activity in the last 180 days.

Also — the scoping_questions_v1.pdf is our questionnaire; we've attached a small sample SCIM delta (example_scim_delta.csv) and a redaction guidance PDF. We'll accept files via a shared Drive link (please use the folder linked here) or if you prefer we can generate a DocuSign transfer link for an encrypted bundle (we'll use that for particularly sensitive files).

Attachment stubs:
- example_scim_delta.csv (sample delta export)
- scoping_questions_v1.pdf (attached earlier)

Anna

From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Initial intake — authorization custody & service-account map (workback + deliverables)

Anna — 

Thanks for the confirmation; we've stood up the extraction workstream and scheduled the runs. Below is the agreed deliverable list and internal owner assignments. We'll upload final artifacts to the Drive folder you provided by end of day Friday (2026-07-09) unless there's a blocker.

Deliverables (what we'll upload to your Drive folder):
- role_map_90d.csv — CSV: role_id, role_name, principal_type (user/service_account), principal_identifier_hashed, binding_start, binding_end, source (SCIM/sync) — owner: karthik.
- service_account_inventory.csv — CSV: account_id_hashed, account_alias, owner_email_hashed, last_token_use_ts, active_role_bindings — owner: marcus.
- example_scim_delta.csv — sample delta with add/remove/update rows (we will redact displayName and email fields in published artifact; mapping file retained internally).
- saml_session_sample.log — redacted assertion logs showing issuer, audience, subject_hashed, authn_instant, session_index, ip (last octet redacted) — owner: karthik.
- README_extracts.md — short notes on extraction queries, timestamp windows, and redaction algorithm.

Notes on redaction: We will apply salted SHA256 for principal identifiers. The mapping file (original_email -> hash) will NOT be uploaded; it remains with Redwood for one-time verification if requested under an NDA.

Attachments we'll include in the Drive bundle as stubs: scoping_questions_v1.pdf, example_scim_delta.csv, saml_session_sample.log

If you'd like the mapping file or raw logs for a limited auditor review, please send us a signed NDA or DocuSign transfer link and we'll coordinate an ephemeral access window.

I'll follow up with a link to the Drive folder once the artifacts are staged.

Best,
Irene
